context.audience: Approved end users and frontline managers

sections.title: What This Tool Does
sections.descriptorLine: Read this before your first session.

blocks.text: The Microsoft 365 Copilot connector lets approved pilot users search and summarize business content that Fixture Client has already made available through configured connector sources. It returns a first draft, not a finished answer, and it does not replace the systems where that content is stored.
Use the connector for work where a fast first pass saves time and you can check the result yourself.

items: Finding a document you know exists but cannot locate by name
Summarizing a long thread or document into a short brief
Drafting routine business writing that you will edit before sending
Pulling together talking points from approved internal material
Final answers that go to a client or a regulator without review
Anything involving credentials, secrets, or access codes
Regulated, financial, health, or legal data outside approved scope
Decisions that need a system of record as the authority

blocks.text: A weak prompt produces a vague answer. Give the connector four things and the quality changes immediately.

rows: You are helping a client account manager
Where to look and what to leave out
Use only the linked project folder
Shape and length of the answer
Five bullets, plain language, under 120 words

blocks.text: Compare the two columns below. The improved version names the source, the audience, and the output shape, so the connector has no room to guess.

rows: Summarize the linked project status thread in five bullets for an account manager, plain language, under 120 words
Find the most recent onboarding checklist in the approved HR folder and give me its title, owner, and last modified date
Draft a short follow-up email to a client confirming next week's review meeting, professional tone, no commitments on pricing

blocks.text: Stop and ask before you continue if any of the following is true.

items: You are unsure whether the content you are about to supply is sensitive
The connector returns content you did not expect to have access to
The output states a fact, figure, or commitment you cannot verify
You are being asked to rely on the output as evidence or as an approval

blocks.text: Route questions about approved use, access, or unexpected results to ORG Support. Route anything involving suspected exposure of sensitive content to the designated security owner immediately, and do not continue the session in the meantime.
